# 上游对齐与完成度

<!-- Generated by scripts/check-upstream.mjs; edit source inputs and regenerate. -->

固定来源为 [Semi Design 2.103.0](https://github.com/DouyinFE/semi-design/tree/8bed560dd3f36579f85b7a522f19762f2bace756)，commit `8bed560dd3f36579f85b7a522f19762f2bace756`。以下数量由固定源码和当前包入口生成：83 个模块族、130 个根具名导出，当前同名根导出 8 个，完整公共模块交付 5 个、公共模块行为验收 5 个。

模块族只统计根入口相对导出的首层非内部目录。BaseComponent、BaseFoundation、semiGlobal 和外部 AI 数据函数另列根导出，不凑入模块族。计数不是行为覆盖率。

“设施/夹具”列登记实际源码、样式或测试支持，不等于完整组件。资源包装和语言字典的交付不自动成为组件验收。

## 已记录的接受映射

### configProvider（已验收）

- API：六props与静态默认断点图、两个订阅重载保留；嵌套继承、稳定wrapper、启用和map刷新通知及失效保护为Vue差异。
- 类型：ConfigProviderProps/ConfigContextValue、Readonly Ref scoped slot与响应式类型明确映射，不暴露React类型。
- 静态成员：ConfigProvider.defaultResponsiveMap 与子路径命名defaultResponsiveMap同一只读对象；无静态子组件。
- 子路径：浏览器UI根提供ConfigProvider/ConfigConsumer/useConfigContext；./configProvider提供default与命名组件、defaultResponsiveMap及类型。Node根保留静态设施。固定上游legacy子路径无exports map，不虚构结构化子路径。
- 决定：The public ConfigProvider and ConfigConsumer browser contracts are accepted against the fixed upstream API with explicit native Vapor slot, own-key inheritance, stable DOM wrapper and responsive lifecycle differences. Source and generated declaration checks, browser and documentation behavior, pure Vapor and separate interop tarball consumers, and resource cleanup passed independent review. Locale data is forwarded through the existing context; public locale components remain outside this acceptance.

### iconButton（已验收）

- API：原生 button/content 结构、图标位置、padding、尺寸/theme/type/block/circle/colorful、loading与disabled优先级、原生表单和事件；children以text/default slot映射，icon以readonly fill作用域slot映射。保留iconSize/iconStyle no-op和分层默认值及prefix限制。
- 类型：IconButtonProps继承Vue原生button属性并区分视觉type/htmlType；IconButtonSlots、IconButtonIconScope和HorizontalPaddingType支持原生Vapor块、只读fill与明确undefined。BaseButton内部声明依赖不是公开出口。
- 静态成员：仅保留elementType = IconButton；无静态子组件、公开实例方法或全局defaults入口。
- 子路径：浏览器根具名IconButton与./iconButton默认/具名同一实现；CSS/SCSS为styles/components/iconButton。固定上游lib/es及lib/cjs旧路径不提供；Node根排除组件和私有BaseButton/未来Button组。
- 决定：Accepted the fixed upstream IconButton browser contract implemented with native Vapor slots and a private BaseButton. Strict source/generated declarations, native events and forms, lifecycle and animation cleanup, themed documentation, per-file coverage, and four isolated tarball consumer flows passed local verification and independent source review. Explicit API and environment differences remain documented; this does not deliver public Button or group components.

### icons（已验收）

- API：Icon span 包装、六种 size、spin、整数 rotate、prefixCls/type/class/style/native attrs 已映射；React svg 节点改为 svg/default slot，fill 由调用方显式读取，ref 改为 getElement()，convertIcon 接收同一 SVG slot 工厂。ARIA 默认装饰性，有名称时为 img；显式 role/aria-hidden 优先。
- 类型：IconProps 映射为 Vue HTMLAttributes、只读 fill、IconSlots 和 IconHandle；另提供 IconSize、IconSvgScope、ConvertedIconProps。源/声明正反类型与实际 tarball 消费验证，不宣称 React 类型同构。
- 静态成员：Icon 与 convertIcon 结果提供 elementType = Icon，无静态子组件。固定上游的动态赋值 marker 不在 AST 静态成员索引中，人工契约和浏览器/类型测试覆盖。
- 子路径：浏览器 semi-icons-vue 根及 ./Icon 提供 default/Icon/convertIcon；semi-ui-vue 根提供具名 Icon，./icons 另提供 default。Node import 的 UI 根仅静态工具且声明一致。固定上游 icons 使用 legacy main/module/types，无 exports map，故不虚构结构化子路径映射；不提供 CJS、SSR 或 hydration。
- 决定：The public Icon browser contract is accepted against the fixed upstream API with explicit Vue slot/ref/ARIA and environment differences. Source and declaration checks, pure Vapor and separate interop browser behavior, documentation examples, package provenance, and four isolated tarball consumer flows passed; the cited contract and evidence were independently reviewed. Acceptance of other public families is recorded independently.

### locale（已验收）

- API：Provider replaces its dictionary and defaults omitted/undefined locale to zh_CN. Consumer selects Config locale then independent Locale locale, validates code and preserves field/dateFns/currency fallback differences. No wrapper DOM, events or exposed methods.
- 类型：Generated Locale is unchanged. Consumer string-key generic, unknown/undefined boundaries and VaporRenderResult slots replace unconstrained React T and positional children callbacks.
- 静态成员：No static child components or public instance methods; defaultProps become synchronous defaults.
- 子路径：Browser root exports both components, hook and types; ./locale aggregates default Provider and named Consumer. Legacy deep component-file paths are not exported. Existing ./locale/source/\* and ./locale/interface retain static Node access.
- 决定：The public LocaleProvider and LocaleConsumer browser contracts are accepted against the fixed upstream language selection and field fallback behavior. Native Vapor scoped slots, explicit dictionary-key generics, independent locale/config contexts and their differences are documented. Strict source and generated declarations, dynamic and isolated browser behavior, live documentation, all 57 generated dictionaries and four isolated tarball consumer flows passed verification and independent implementation review. Other public families remain independently assessed.

### spin（已验收）

- API：三尺寸、spinning/delay、文本tip、wrapperClassName/childStyle和遮罩保留来源语义；React节点改原生default/indicator/tip slots。初次truthy delay仍可立即显示；后续取消、延迟重配和过期回调由既有scope管理。default slot存在决定block。根仅转发声明的class/style、role/ARIA/data；无事件、model或公开实例方法。
- 类型：SpinProps/SpinSize映射固定来源；VaporRenderResult slots、StyleValue与有限DOM属性替代ReactNode/CSSProperties。SpinSlots是新增Vue类型。正反例覆盖原始文本/null/Promise slot与不支持属性边界。
- 静态成员：保留只读Spin.**SemiComponentName** = Spin；无静态子组件。getDerivedStateFromProps是React生命周期，不作为公开静态API导出；默认值通过实例配置解析与Vue响应式状态实现。
- 子路径：浏览器根具名Spin/types；semi-ui-vue/spin提供default/named Spin与types。Node根仅静态设施。上游./lib/es/spin、./lib/es/spin/icon、./lib/es/spin/icon.js、./lib/es/spin/index和./lib/es/spin/index.js未作为兼容路径公开；内部icon与状态机不导出。无CJS、组件SSR或水合。
- 决定：The public Spin browser contract is accepted against the fixed upstream defaults, derived loading state, DOM and styles. Native Vapor slot and attribute differences, instance-scoped delay cancellation, global-default edge cases, source/generated declarations, live documentation, Chromium behavior and four isolated tarball consumers passed complete local verification and independent review. Other public families remain independently assessed.

## API、类型与路径差异

当前 `semiGlobal` 是 Vue 初始化默认值设施；没有 React `createRoot`，默认值捕获时机也不同。同名不代表 API 或行为对齐。各族 API、类型、静态成员与子路径映射由显式接受记录单独说明；未接受的条目仍需逐项交付。

可提交的 `resources/upstream/baseline.json` 记录上游每个输入的指纹、类型语法、静态成员、子路径和资源；`matrix.json` 另列当前根值/类型导出、六包导出条件与资源支持范围。类型语法指纹用于发现变化，不代表 React 类型已转成 Vue 类型，也不证明语义兼容。动态构造的静态 API 保留解析限制，需要人工复核。当前不提供上游的 React `lib/es` / `lib/cjs` 路径或公共组件 CJS。

[资源索引](./resource-index.md)、[本地产物与消费方式](./packages.md)和[兼容边界](./compatibility.md)分别说明已交付资源、ESM/声明、纯 Vapor 与 interop、严格安装与 SSR 限制。
